title: CarbonLEI re-check of accepted verifications
description: Output of `carbonlei recheck --json`, of POST /v1/recheck and of `recheckRecords` in sdk/recheck.ts (format 1). Every record is re-verified at one pinned block and compared with the verdict the importer accepted. Exit codes: 3 if any record could not be re-checked (severity error), else 1 if any needs action, else 0. Not a CBAM declaration and not a CBAM Registry document.

pinnedBlock.description: The one block every re-check of the run read.

blockTime.description: Timestamp of the pinned block, UNIX seconds.

windowHours.description: CONTESTED window after registration used for the run (default 24).

skipped.description: POST /v1/recheck only: input items that were not records.

binding.description: POST /v1/recheck only: HMAC-SHA256 of the server over the canonical JSON of this document without `binding`; POST /v1/portfolio accepts the document as `recheck` only with it.

change.description: What changed since acceptance. action: REPORT_REVOKED, REPORT_SUPERSEDED, REPORT_EXPIRED, REPORT_NOT_ON_LEDGER, CLAIM_NOT_ON_LEDGER, SHIPMENT_CHANGED, AUDITOR_REVOKED_OR_BODY_SUSPENDED, ADDRESS_ROTATED, REVOCATION_CONTESTED, CONTESTED, AUTHORITY_INVALID, ANCHOR_INVALID, NOW_INVALID, NOW_INCOMPLETE. info: BECAME_FINAL, WINDOW_OPEN, IMPROVED, EXPIRED_SINCE. none: UNCHANGED, STILL_NOT_VALID. error: RECHECK_FAILED.

source.description: File (and line) the record came from.

mode.description: full: the proof was verified again (all its checks: 0-8, plus 9 and 10 when it carries a precursor or carbon-price statement); ledger-only: no proof attached, only the report's on-chain status was read.

at.description: When the record says it was accepted (ISO 8601).

overall.description: VALID, INVALID, CONTESTED or INCOMPLETE; in ledger-only mode INVALID or NOT_REVERIFIED.

verdict.description: The full current verdict (mode full), else null.

proofSha256.description: SHA-256 of the proof bytes re-verified (mode full), else null. A verify-batch line takes over a verdict that is not worse only when this equals its proofSha256; a results line whose recorded proofSha256 the found file does not match is RECHECK_FAILED.
